propositions: inspect-ai is never imported in src/rebar; the sole reference is the _optional.py registry name string
the [eval] extra is the only member and sole reason for two [tool.uv] conflicts entries (eval vs bedrock, eval vs dev) that prevent dev and bedrock from coexisting
the click>=8.3.3 override in pyproject.toml exists only to work around inspect-ai's stale click < 8.2.2 cap, which held the project on vulnerable click 8.2.1 and failed pip-audit gating
a pytest smoke test gated on [eval] would execute in zero CI lanes because only prompt-eval.yml's eval-live job installs it, and that job is dispatch/weekly-only, continue-on-error, and pytest-less
the module docstring in eval.py falsely claims the live run routes through Inspect AI, contradicting its own implementation comment that explicitly disclaims this routing
removing inspect-ai, the [eval] extra, both conflicts entries, and the click override dissolves all machinery that exists solely to accommodate an unused dependency
